title: Oozing Peruvian Beef Lomo Saltado
description: A comforting Peruvian stew with beef, onions, potatoes, and a splash of pink food color, simmered to a thick, creamy oozing consistency in a copper mug.

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin, trimmed, cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a copper mug over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the beef cubes and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and soy sauce, stir to coat, then pour in enough water to just cover the solids.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and reduce heat to low; cook for 45 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the liquid has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then add a drop of pink food coloring, stirring until evenly distributed.
Remove from heat and let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Ladle the oozing stew into a copper mug and enjoy warm.
